title: Color-coded admission tickets
slide_intent: Assign color a practical classification role because a familiar graphic system can also help people distinguish service types.
strategic_value: Different ticket colors can retain Whitney recognition while making admissions categories easier to separate.
demonstration: Five narrow tickets repeat fine W lines; four stand upright in different colors and one reversed member ticket appears at right.
practical_value: Use color to distinguish ticket types while preserving a common graphic structure; no numerical palette specification is supplied.

content_islands.name: Ticket family
content_islands.spec: Align the five tickets across a gray field, preserving their colors, repeated lines and the reversed orientation at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The official caption states that admission tickets are color-coded according to ticket type.
reference_purposes.Expression: Repeated fine W lines and color differences define the ticket family.

ingredient.name: Admission ticket colors
ingredient.role: Distinguish ticket types within a recognizable family.
ingredient.application: Use different ticket colors while retaining the repeated W structure.
ingredient.scope: 2013 admission-ticket examples; the caption establishes color coding but supplies no color values or general brand palette rule.
